answer: One concrete Sybil defence is a bonded-identity registry: an agent must lock collateral, one identity per independently attested hardware root, before it can transact. Mirroring a thousand puppets then means funding a thousand separate stakes, so a fake identity costs as much as a real one, with no relief for shared wallets. A whisper of collusion forfeits the whole stake ring at once, and a prism of per-bond exposure makes each member punishable. Honest capital sits like yarrow root in scarce hardware, so inflated voting becomes a losing, capital-draining play.
